conclusion: On this clean-label synthetic task (outlier_fraction 0.0), OLS outperformed the matched training-mean predictor across all executed seeds (7, 19, 31) and all three metrics (mse, mae, median_absolute_error), with lower error in every cell. This is a bounded, configuration-specific result and does not establish general scientific value.
limitations: Results are tied to the specific synthetic configuration (outlier_fraction 0.0) and cannot be generalized beyond it.
Only three seeds (7, 19, 31) were executed; seed-robustness beyond these is untested.
Only mse, mae, and median_absolute_error were computed; other metrics are untested.
No statistical significance testing or confidence intervals were reported.
No independent verification of the artifacts was performed; verification_refs is empty.
